edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Rebuttal like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: Rebuttal returns his Q and E2 chain — melee or not, the glow forces him to open without his poke or pull. Walk him off CS with it.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: His Kingslayer lunge and Abscond dash are not projectiles — only Chain Lash and the E2 chain are. Save Rebuttal for the pull, not the jump.
